member.name: T:EntityForge.Utility.WildcardMatch
member.summary: Matches strings against patterns containing '?' for one character and '*' for any sequence of characters.

member.name: M:EntityForge.Utility.WildcardMatch.EqualsWildcard(System.String,System.String)
member.summary: Tests a case-sensitive wildcard match; returns false if either input is null.
member.param: A pattern containing literal characters, '?' and '*'.
member.returns: Whether the complete text matches the pattern.

member.name: M:EntityForge.Utility.WildcardMatch.EqualsWildcard(System.String,System.String,System.Boolean)
